title: Is Anthropic's growth the market's or its own?
subtitle: Dots: each company's growth over the latest 13 weeks against the 13 weeks before, in two dimensions. Bars: Anthropic minus OpenAI, the part that is Anthropic's own once the market (OpenAI) is taken out.
takeaway: Anthropic grew faster than OpenAI in 1 of 2 dimensions over the latest 13 weeks.
Its widest lead is in SDK downloads (+22 points) and its narrowest in Coding-agent CLI downloads (-74 points).
assumptions: OpenAI stands in for the market: what both share is market growth, and the difference is Anthropic's own. A negative bar means OpenAI grew faster, or fell less.
Each dimension is a weekly series summed over the latest 13 complete weeks and compared with the 13 before: SDK downloads (PyPI plus npm), and coding-agent CLI downloads (npm).
The Briefing compares every signal over 3 months; this page takes the same view across two dimensions and splits it into market and own.
Download spikes are removed as on the Developer Adoption page (a day above 10 times the median around it). A week left with 5 or 6 clean days is scaled to 7; with fewer it is dropped.
Weeks run Monday to Sunday and only complete weeks are used.
Correlation is not cause. A lead shows what moved first, not why.
